purpose: Teach: のぞみ/りゅう/秀樹/和彦/優作/三男/英男/誠一

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがのぞみ号、つまり新幹線のぞみに乗ろうって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was talking about taking the Nozomi bullet train.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gently sharing what she heard. Unhurried. The ease of someone relaying a small family detail between people who care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとりゅうおじさんの家に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I went to visit Dad and Uncle Ryu.
lines.style: Bright and direct, eager to share. Small voice but genuine. The unselfconscious excitement of a child reporting something real that happened to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「西城秀樹のヤングマンを一緒に歌おう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying you should sing Hideki Saijo's 'Young Man' together.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. Like she's holding the sweetness of the idea. Measured pace. Gentle on the detail — not performing, just passing it along.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと和彦おじさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I went to see Dad and Uncle Kazuhiko.
lines.style: Straightforward, present-tense energy. Small but solid. The particular way a quiet child speaks when he's been somewhere real and wants you to know it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「松田優作のドラマは深い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying Yusaku Matsuda's dramas have real depth to them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Slight pause before the main idea — like she's considering the weight of what he said. Quiet respect for the observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「三男のお父さんの苦労」を聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I asked Dad about what it's like being the youngest son.
lines.style: Quieter than before. The tone of someone who listened to something harder than usual. Unhurried. A small but real seriousness underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「英男おじさんの絵を観に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying you should go see Uncle Hideo's paintings.
lines.style: Inviting, warm suggestion. Slight lift on the idea of the outing — like she's imagining it with him. Gentle insistence. The ease of someone who knows he'd enjoy it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと誠一おじさんの結婚式に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I went to Dad and Uncle Seiichi's wedding.
lines.style: Bright closure. A sense of having been part of something — not just present but included. Small, genuine satisfaction. The natural end to a day well-lived.
